verdict.rationale: Dynadot's security page documents an optional Registry Lock and an "account lock" alongside 2FA, which covers the registry-lock half of the story. Nothing shows a domain-level transfer lock applied by default, and "account lock" is not clearly the same thing. Missing for 10: evidence of a transfer lock enabled by default on domains, any detail on how Registry Lock works (eligible TLDs, process, cost), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
